Resolves #20364

Aligns cell component lifecycle across `Neo.grid.Row`, `Neo.table.Body`, and `Neo.functional.component.Base`:
- `src/grid/Row.mjs`: widens `if (rendererOutput instanceof Component)` to `AbstractComponent` so functional cell components (`Neo.functional.component.Base`) are registered in `row.components[column.dataField]`, emit `createVdomReference()`, and receive `mounted` / `theme` / `windowId` / `destroy` lifecycle forwarding.
- `src/functional/component/Base.mjs`: clones `me.vdom` onto the instance in `construct(config)` (matching `Neo.component.Base#construct`) so multiple instances of a functional component across grid or table rows do not share `FunctionalBase.prototype.vdom`.
- `src/table/Body.mjs`: adds `afterSetMounted(value, oldValue)` forwarding `mounted` to `this.createdCellComponents`, passes `mounted: me.mounted` and `parentComponent: me` when instantiating config-returned cell components, and passes `component: me.createdCellComponents?.get(cellId)` into `column.renderer.call(...)` so record-keyed cell components are reused across `recordChange` and `store.sort()` without cross-record state leakage.

Evidence: L3 (Chromium browser e2e in `test/playwright/e2e/grid/FunctionalComponentCell.spec.mjs`, component browser spec in `test/playwright/component/grid/ColumnRendererScope.spec.mjs`, and Playwright unit specs in `test/playwright/unit/table/BodyRendererInstances.spec.mjs` and `test/playwright/unit/grid/column/Component.spec.mjs`) → L3 required (browser rendering of functional components in grid cells plus unit lifecycle verification).

agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline pre-commit checks ran.

## Deltas from ticket
- Also fixed `Neo.functional.component.Base#construct` (`src/functional/component/Base.mjs`) to clone `me.vdom` per instance (matching `Neo.component.Base#construct`), surfaced by the multi-row browser e2e test (`FunctionalComponentCell.spec.mjs`) where two `FunctionalButton` instances previously mutated the shared `FunctionalBase.prototype.vdom` object.

## Test Evidence
- Red-on-base / green-at-head browser e2e verification (`npx playwright test test/playwright/e2e/grid/FunctionalComponentCell.spec.mjs -c test/playwright/playwright.config.e2e.mjs`):
  - On `origin/dev` `src/grid/Row.mjs`: fails with `Locator: locator('#grid-component-columns .neo-grid-cell[data-field="action"][data-record-id="1"]').locator('button.neo-button') — Expected: "action:Octo One", Error: element(s) not found` and `App Worker: vdom update failed neo-grid-body-1 TypeError: childNodes.map is not a function at VDom.syncVdomState`.
  - At PR head (`109bc738e1`): `1 passed (743ms)` (and `ColumnRendererScope.spec.mjs`: `8 passed (4.6s)`).

## Evolution
Pivoted from row-index slot keying (`getCellComponentId`) back to record-scoped `cellId` in `table.Body#applyRendererOutput` after Round 1 review falsified slot rotation on omitted config keys across `store.sort()`. Because `table.Body` renders every record without row pooling, keeping record-scoped `cellId` while passing `component: me.createdCellComponents?.get(cellId)` reuses each record's component instance across `recordChange` and `store.sort()` with zero cross-record state leakage.

**Challenge OR documented search (per guide §7.1):**

- **Challenge**: row-slot rotation leaks state between records (RA-1).
  - **Setup:** a renderer of the common shape `({record}) => ({module: Button, text: record.name, ...(record.vip && {iconCls: 'fa fa-star'})})`, records Alpha (`vip: true`, `rank: 2`) and Beta (`vip: false`, `rank: 1`), then a sort by rank.
  - **At this head:** row 0 shows **Beta with Alpha's star** (`iconCls "fa fa-star"`). Slot 0's button is `set()` with Beta's config, which omits `iconCls`, so Alpha's value survives.
  - **At base `d0ab9459dc`**, keyed by record: row 0 shows Beta with `iconCls null`, because each record keeps its own button.
  - **Why it's broader than this renderer:** `grid.column.Component` survives pooling only because its config has a fixed shape and it maps `undefined → null`. Renderers return arbitrary configs, and a key that is simply omitted can't be caught that way.
- **Documented search**: I actively looked for these:
